```{python}
def load_data(csv_path):
    df = pd.read_csv(
        csv_path,
        dtype = {
            "fipstate": str, 
            "FIPSTATE": str,
            "fipscty": str,
            "FIPSCTY": str}
    )
    return df
```

while total_qtrly_wages and taxable_qtrly_wages looks like variables we would want, they are all zero at the county level for every year in our dataset due to privacy laws forcing the government to obsure that information. 
```{python}

def duck_db_load_data(csv_path):
    df = duckdb.query(f"""
        SELECT
            area_fips,
            agglvl_code,
            year,
            qtr,
            qtrly_estabs
        FROM '{csv_path}' 
        WHERE industry_code = '518'
    """).df()
    return df
```

```{python}
def combine_quarters(df):
    df = df.groupby(by=["area_fips", "agglvl_code", "year"], as_index=False).max()
    df = df.drop(columns=["qtr"])
    return df
```

```{python}
def filter_to_only_county_level_observations(df):
    df = df[df["agglvl_code"]==75]
    df = df.drop(columns = ["agglvl_code"])
    return df
```

```{python}
# remove all fips codes which are non-county aggregations (those that end in 999)
def remove_non_county_id_codes(df):
    df = df[~df["county_id"].astype(str).str.contains(r"^\d{2}999")]
    return df
```

all estabs data is zero until the year 2004 for the NAICS code 518
```{python}
# main loop
list_of_df = []

for file_year in np.arange(2004,2026):

    csv_path = data_dir / "qrtly_census_emp_and_wages" / f"{file_year}_q1_q4_naics_518_data_only.csv"

    df_raw = duck_db_load_data(csv_path)
    #df_raw = own_code_to_title(df_raw)
    #df_raw = size_code_to_title(df_raw)
    df_raw = combine_quarters(df_raw)
    df_raw = filter_to_only_county_level_observations(df_raw)
    df_raw.columns = ["county_id", "year", "estabs"]
    df_raw = remove_non_county_id_codes(df_raw)
    df_final = dbu.remove_rows_not_in_mainland_states(df_raw, "county_id")

    list_of_df.append(df_raw)

df_final = pd.concat(list_of_df, ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
# export cleaned data to sql table in local db
df_final.to_sql(
    "naics_518_establishments",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
